Good morning.
Christ is King 👑 
The Heavens reveal His Glory.
To the very ends of the Earth.
Beyond the stars.
God is in control.
Rejoice

Former astronaut describes what it feels like to blast off to the moon.

He says you’re going 100 MPH before you even clear the tower. You’re going Mach 1 in 45 seconds—and you NEVER STOP ACCELERATING.

Then wait until you hear about the food!

Video

The National Mall celebrated the launch of ARTEMIS II right.

Beautiful tribute to NASA.

Video

President Trump: “The world is watching… the United States will be safer, stronger, more prosperous, and greater than it’s ever been… May God bless the men and women of the United States Armed Forces, and may God bless the United States of America.”

Video

President Trump: “Tonight, every American can look forward to a day when we are finally free from the wickedness of Iranian aggression and the specter of nuclear blackmail. We are on the cusp of ending Iran’s sinister threat to America and the world.”

Video

President Trump: “Thanks to the progress we’ve made, I can say tonight that we are on-track to complete all of America’s military objectives shortly. We are going to hit them extremely hard over the next two to three weeks... discussions are ongoing.”

Video

President Trump warns Iran: “If there is no deal we are going to hit each and every one of their electric generating plants very hard and… simultaneously… They have no anti-aircraft equipment… We are unstoppable as a military force.”

Video

President Trump on his pursuit of peace with Iran: “My first preference was always the path of diplomacy. Yet, the regime continued their relentless quest for nuclear weapons, and rejected every attempt at an agreement.”

Video

President Trump on the fallen patriots: “We must honor them by completing the mission for which they gave their lives… The loved ones said, please, sir, please finish the job… And we are going to finish the job, and we’re going to finish it very fast!”

Video

President Trump: “Tonight, Iran’s navy is gone, their air force is in ruins, their leaders, most of them... are now dead… Our enemies are losing—and America, as it has been for five years under my presidency, is winning…winning bigger than ever before.”

Video

🚨BREAKING: President Trump congratulates the NASA astronauts on their successful launch of Artemis II:

“It will be traveling further than any manned rocket has ever flown and will… pass the moon, go around it, and come back home… It’s amazing.”
